messages:
Maria L: Heads up — router-error-rate (alert: router_err_rate_high) started spiking ~02:10 UTC during the nightly canary rollout. This is expected for the canary cohort. Can we request a short suppression (30m) while the rollout finishes? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Jon P: Do you have the grafana link and are you sure it's only the canary tenant? I want to confirm before we touch alerts.

Maria L: Grafana: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/routers/router-metrics?from=now-1h&to=now — look at "router_errors_per_minute" by tenant.
Trace sample: https://traces.internal/trace/abc123 (shows spike from tenant: canary-42)
Query I used:
```
sum by (tenant) (rate(router_errors_total[5m]))
```
It's confined to tenant=canary-42 and a couple short bursts from canary-43.

Alex K: ok. two options: 1) short suppression for 30m while canary finishes, 2) tweak alert to ignore tenants with label canary=true or exclude tenant ids. I prefer 1 now and follow up with 2.

Maria L: Proposed suppression command for oncall bot:
`/suppress-alert router_err_rate_high duration=30m reason="nightly canary rollout"`
Or via Alertmanager API:
```
curl -XPOST -d '{"matchers":[{"name":"alertname","value":"router_err_rate_high"}],"startsAt":"2026-03-17T02:12:00Z","endsAt":"2026-03-17T02:42:00Z","createdBy":"maria","comment":"canary rollout"}' https://alertmanager.internal/api/v2/silences
```

Jon P: If we do tweak the rule later, suggested quick patch is to add `and tenant!~"canary-.*"` to the PromQL or add `- tenant=~"canary-.*"` in the Grafana alert filter. Bumping threshold from 0.03 -> 0.06 could also reduce noise but may hide real regressions.

Ops SRE: +1 to 30m suppression. Please add a runbook note and create a short ticket to make the exclusion permanent. Runbook note template: "If router_err_rate_high fires during nightly rollout, verify tenant labels, suppress 30m, and follow up with engineering to exclude canary tenants."

Alex K: I'm going to suppress now. /suppress-alert router_err_rate_high 30m — tagging @sre-oncall. Will monitor p95/calls for next 30m.

SRE Bot: Silence created (id: S-3321). Ends at 2026-03-17T02:42:00Z. Creator: Alex K. :white_check_mark:

Maria L: Thanks — I'll open a ticket to add the tenant exclusion and ping infra for a safer rollout rule. Ticket: https://issues.internal/RW-1243 (will add notes + dashboard screenshot).

Alex K: great. I'll watch dashboards for recovery and un-snooze early if needed. :eyes:
